goal: implementation plan item 4, the part never re-run: repeated load, prepare, execute and audit inside one broker session
what_was_missing: the phase matrices covered pause, cancel and fault. Repetition was not covered: every earlier session ran one task, so nothing showed that the broker carries no state from a finished task into the next one.

session.note: each round asks for a different rectangle, so a retained plan or a stale coverage report cannot pass by looking like the previous one

checks_per_round: the broker reports editable before a new task is accepted
the previewed request carries the new region, not the previous one
coverage from the previous task is cleared by prepare
captured_rows and captured_blocks are back to zero before the new task starts
the task reaches ACQUIRED at HOLD
the audit reports the new region, not the previous one
each round gets its own task directory

archive_drain.note: four consecutive releases plus the closing cancel probe, each draining its archive cleanly. This is the repetition pressure the drain work of 2026-09-13 had only been shown to survive once.

findings: four load, prepare, execute and audit cycles in one broker session all reached ACQUIRED at HOLD with ESTIMATED_COMPLETE coverage, no unverified span and no quality flag
nothing leaked between tasks: coverage cleared, counters zeroed, and every audit reported its own region
each of the five task directories closed its archive with drained true and no write errors, and no executor log carries a traceback
the closing cancel probe still works after four completed tasks, so the session is not left in a state that only tolerates one mission
not_covered: GUI follow and zoom are covered separately by tools/validate_gui_camera.py and were not re-run here
four rounds of a 3 x 2 m region, not a repeated full area
rounds differ only in length; a round that changes speed, spacing or start point was not exercised

round one's steady real-time factor was 0.9077 against 0.9986 for the identical configuration twenty minutes earlier in the same WSL instance, which is the instance decay recorded on 2026-09-12 and deliberately not chased here
